text:
A regular hexagon can be partitioned into 6 equilateral triangles by connecting the center to each vertex. The perimeter of one equilateral triangle is 21 inches, so each side of the triangle is \(21 \div 3 = 7\) inches. The outer side of each triangle is also a side of the hexagon, so the hexagon has 6 sides of length 7 inches. Its perimeter is \(6 \times 7 = 42\) inches.

Answer: 42
